name: Riyadh Smart City
summary:
Smart Riyadh: The Vision 2030 Transformation
Dive into an unparalleled Extended Reality (XR) experience and witness the dramatic, data-driven story of Riyadh's evolution from a congested, developing city into one of the world's leading smart and sustainable metropolises. Designed specifically for the immersive capabilities of the Meta Quest platform, this application is your virtual passport to the achievements of Saudi Vision 2030.
